instruction: Look at freecad_task-1_input.step in FreeCAD. Turn the plain fixture plate into a precision fixture plate while keeping the 180 x 100 x 12 mm outer plate envelope fixed. Add two raised cylindrical bosses on the top face at (35,50) and (145,50), each diameter 22 mm and height 10 mm. Cut a shallow centered top pocket 82 x 38 mm, centered at (90,50), 5 mm deep so its floor is at Z=7 mm. Cut four vertical obround through slots of total length 32 mm and width 9 mm at centers (45,25), (135,25), (45,75), and (135,75), all slots running along X. Cut six vertical through holes of diameter 7 mm on a bolt circle of radius 36 mm centered at (90,50), starting on +X and repeating every 60 degrees, and cut a vertical through hole of diameter 9 mm through each raised boss. Fuse all added material into one solid, export only /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-1_output.step, and do not create extra output files. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
